items.question: In the UAE work/residence permit health screening, which categories of workers must test negative for syphilis and Hepatitis B?
items.gold: Workers in nurseries, domestic workers (housemaids, nannies and drivers), food handlers and restaurant/cafe workers, saloon and beauty centre workers, and health club workers.
items.fact: Five worker categories must test negative for syphilis and Hepatitis B

items.question: Under the 2016 UAE Cabinet Resolution on TB screening at residence visa renewal, how long is the residence visa issued to a person with active or drug-resistant TB?
items.gold: One year, with a conditional fitness certificate and mandatory treatment in the UAE.
items.fact: Active or drug-resistant TB gets one-year conditional residence visa
